column3: (CSP: directive or wildcard findings — reviewed, see STORY-031)
(Strict-Transport-Security — sent only over https, which this stack has no terminator for)
(Server leaks version information via the Server header)
(Timestamp disclosure — the product shows timestamps on purpose)
(Information disclosure: suspicious comments in the built JavaScript)
(Modern web application — informational: it says the app uses JavaScript)
(Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy / Embedder-Policy — sent since the first real scan)
(Permissions-Policy — sent since the first real scan; camera, microphone, location, payment off)
(Sec-Fetch-* missing — request headers the scanner's own client did not send; nothing for a server to set)
(Storable but non-cacheable — deliberate: index.html is no-cache so a deploy takes effect at once)
(Base64 disclosure — a false positive: the build hashes asset file names, e.g. fraunces-…-7BpKI3vF.woff2)
